mapper.sql: emp42_eval_grade_id AS eval_grade_id, emp42_eval_list_std_id AS eval_list_std_id, emp42_grade AS grade, emp42_grade_weight AS grade_weight, emp42_grade_score AS grade_score, emp42_compare_cd AS compare_code, f_cdnm('CompareCode', emp42_compare_cd, emp40_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS compare_name, emp42_reason_yn AS reason_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM emp42_eval_grade INNER JOIN emp40_eval_list_std ON emp40_eval_list_std_id = emp42_eval_list_std_id WHERE emp42_eval_list_std_id = #{evalListStdId} ORDER BY emp42_grade_score DESC

SELECT FROM emp42_eval_grade INNER JOIN emp40_eval_list_std ON emp40_eval_list_std_id = emp42_eval_list_std_id WHERE emp40_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp40_start_date) FROM emp41_eval_list INNER JOIN emp40_eval_list_std ON emp41_eval_list_std_id = emp40_eval_list_std_id WHERE emp40_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp40_start_date <= f_today() ) AND emp40_company_id = #{companyId}
